# React Bits upstream sources

`DotGrid.jsx` and `DotGrid.css` are unmodified file contents retrieved 2026-10-19 from https://reactbits.dev/r/DotGrid-JS-CSS.json . Component page: https://www.reactbits.dev/backgrounds/dot-grid . The same copyright and MIT + Commons Clause license below apply. Adaptation: `ui/components/DotGrid.jsx`, global integration: `ui/components/AppBackdrop.jsx`. See `OPEN_SOURCE.md` for original hashes and modifications.

Retrieved 2026-10-19 from https://reactbits.dev/r/LatticeLoader-JS-CSS.json .
Component page: https://www.reactbits.dev/micro/lattice-loader .

`LatticeLoader.jsx` and `LatticeLoader.css` are unmodified registry file contents. The runnable LISHI adaptation is in `ui/components/`. Copyright (c) 2026 David Haz; MIT + Commons Clause, retained in `licenses/ReactBits-LICENSE.md` at the application root. See `OPEN_SOURCE.md` for hashes and changes. These files are included as part of the LISHI application source, rather than offered as a standalone component distribution.

`BranchedMenu.jsx` and `BranchedMenu.css` are unmodified registry contents retrieved 2026-10-19 from https://reactbits.dev/r/BranchedMenu-JS-CSS.json . Component page: https://www.reactbits.dev/micro/branched-menu . The same copyright and license apply. The runnable recursive category adaptation is in `ui/components/`.

`Magnet.jsx` is the unmodified JSX file from the official registry https://reactbits.dev/r/Magnet-JS-CSS.json retrieved 2026-10-19. Component page: https://www.reactbits.dev/animations/magnet . The same copyright and license apply. See `ui/components/Magnet.jsx` for the limited-motion, stable-hit-target adaptation and `OPEN_SOURCE.md` for its hash and changes.

`Masonry.jsx` and `Masonry.css` are unmodified file contents from https://reactbits.dev/r/Masonry-JS-CSS.json retrieved 2026-10-19. Component page: https://www.reactbits.dev/components/masonry . The same copyright and license apply. The library gallery adaptation reuses layout and spring reflow, with existing asset interaction and a separate top title row; see `ui/components/Masonry.jsx` and `OPEN_SOURCE.md`.
